transcript: My friend, if you are watching this, it means you chose to be here, not to consume more content, but to return to yourself. Today, I want to speak to you about something very simple, not success, not healing techniques, not productivity. Return. Most people are not tired because they are doing too much. They are tired because they are never home inside themselves. They wake up and immediately leave their body into the phone, into worries, into comparison, into yesterday, into tomorrow, and they do not come back. So today, I want to give you a private practice. Nothing dramatic, just this. Before you speak to anyone, before you check anything, sit on the edge of your bed, close your eyes, take one slow breath, and ask yourself one question, where am I right now? Not physically, emotionally, energetically. Are you tight? Are you rushed? Are you heavy? Do not try to fix it, just acknowledge it. Awareness is the first form of self-respect. Then place your hand on your chest and say quietly, I am here. That is all. No affirmations, no forcing positivity, no pretending, just presence. Inside this inner circle, we practice depth, not performance. Out there, people want quick inspiration. In here, we build nervous system safety. We build inner stability. We build a life that does not collapse when things go wrong. And that starts with returning. Do this for seven days, not perfectly, just honestly, and notice what changes. I am proud of you for choosing this path. I will see you in the next teaching.
